children: Singapore, October 16, 2026-- Moody's Ratings has affirmed the Baa3 local currency and foreign currency issuer ratings of Housing and Urban Development Corp Ltd. We have also affirmed HUDCO's Baa3 LC and FC senior unsecured medium-term note program ratings. The outlook on HUDCO's ratings remains stable, reflecting the stable outlook on India's sovereign rating.

title: Moody's Ratings affirms Housing and Urban Development Corp Ltd's Baa3 rating, outlook stable
